race.comment: VULCANA (11) made an encouraging debut last time out, finishing half a length from the winner in second over 1200m at Warrnambool. Should improve sharply and this looks a nice race. NIALAH (6) finished eighth when resuming two runs back then did a good job last start but found a couple better over 1300m at Bendigo, beaten just under a length when she appreciated the step up in trip. Gets a further slight increase here and should be at peak fitness. AFFAIR D'OR (1) is the most interesting runner in the race, being from the same stable as Strictly Business, who won this race last year before winning the Oaks 13 days later. This girl is by Home Affairs, though, and has been trialling well. ANGLAIS (2) logged another third last start, but was beaten a long way and hopefully the blinkers will spark improvement. HURRICANE GIRL (4) has run top four in three of her four starts and draws to get the chance to do so again.
